component.name: System Monitor
component.summary: CPU, memory, GPU, disk and network at a glance in the COSMIC™ panel

description.p: A panel applet that shows CPU, memory, GPU, disk and network use at a glance, and costs close to nothing while you're not looking at it.

ul.li: Two rows of up to four items in the panel, stacked or on one line, built in the settings: CPU, memory, swap, any GPU's load, temperature or VRAM, a filesystem, disk and network rates, and NVMe drive temperatures
An item turns red when its value crosses its own limit
A popup with 2-minute graphs, per-core load, every GPU, network interface, mount and NVMe drive, and the top processes by CPU and memory
Never wakes a suspended discrete GPU, so hybrid laptops keep their battery life
Opens COSMIC's System Monitor from the popup or with a right click

screenshot.caption: The panel button and the popup in two columns: CPU, memory, GPUs, network, disks and processes
The settings: the panel button, the process monitor, the popup's layout and when it warns
Building the panel button: two rows of items to move, retarget or add to
